description_en: Queries NIS traffic ranking analysis results
description_zh: 查询NIS流量排序分析结果
name: DescribeNisTrafficRanking

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic ranking analysis result. Set this parameter to the value returned by the StartNisTrafficRanking operation
parameters.help_zh: 流量排序分析结果 ID，根据StartNisTrafficRanking接口返回进行传入
parameters.name: nis_traffic_ranking_id

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，取值范围：1~100，默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

FlowRankingList.description_en: The list of traffic ranking analysis results
FlowRankingList.description_zh: 流量排序分析结果列表

BindingResourceId.description_en: The instance resource to which the EIP is bound
BindingResourceId.description_zh:
EIP 所绑定的实例资源。
当查询共享带宽指标分析时，该字段才会返回

BindingResourceType.description_en: The type of the instance resource to which the EIP is bound
BindingResourceType.description_zh:
EIP 所绑定的实例资源类型。
当查询共享带宽指标分析时，该字段才会返回。
枚举有：
      - EIP_ECS：云服务器ECS实例类型
      - EIP_ENI：负载均衡SLB实例类型
      - EIP_NAT：NAT网关实例类型
      - EIP_SLB：弹性网卡实例类型
      - HAVIP_ECS：高可用虚拟IP类型
      - TARGET_IP：IP类型

Bytes.description_zh:
带宽。
当VPC/TR/共享带宽分析时，该字段均会返回

BytesIncrease.description_en:
The bandwidth increase amount.
This field is returned only when TrafficScenario is set to TRFlowlog and the Order by field is set to BytesIncrease or BytesIncreaseRatio
BytesIncrease.description_zh:
带宽增长量。
当TrafficScenario = TRFlowlog，且Order by 字段为BytesIncrease或BytesIncreaseRatio 时，该字段才会返回

BytesIncreaseRatio.description_en:
The bandwidth growth rate.
This field is returned only when TrafficScenario is set to TRFlowlog and the Order by field is set to BytesIncrease or BytesIncreaseRatio
BytesIncreaseRatio.description_zh:
带宽增长率。
当TrafficScenario = TRFlowlog，且Order by 字段为BytesIncrease或BytesIncreaseRatio 时，该字段才会返回

BytesRate.description_zh:
流量占比。
当TR和VPC流日志分析时，该字段才会返回

ClientAsn.description_zh:
